analysis: R5 Phase-Field Extraction Defect Root Cause and R6 Specification

predecessor_review.defect_mechanism: Falling through to v[-1] on 2-component nodal U output interprets U2 displacement as U3 damage, which subsequent clamping against d0 conceals instead of failing closed.

valid_layouts: >=3 component displacement field with damage in U3 (index 2)
r6_specification.fail_closed_behavior: Raise explicit ValueError with diagnostic before clipping against d0 or updating damage field
